gaps.note: Not justified and in general false. The computation gives only O(f^sigma u^{1-sigma}) <= O(f^sigma d^{vartheta(1-sigma)}); this is <= f^lambda only if f >= d^{vartheta(1-sigma)/(lambda-sigma)}, which is much larger than the internal-node threshold f >= d^vartheta (at f about d^vartheta it exceeds f^lambda). The paper (lines 2420-2430) stops at O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) and keeps it as a separate term, d^{sigma+beta(1-sigma)}, in the final bound with the larger exponent lambda' > max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (lines 2440-2450), so the page's conclusion is stronger than the paper's.
